# Mitra.net

> Mitra.net is the internet service brand of PT Multimedia Internet Network, serving customers from Tungkal Ilir, West Tanjung Jabung, Jambi, Indonesia.

## Website

- [Mitra.net homepage](https://multimediainternetnetwork.com/): Internet packages, company background, FAQs, and contact information.
- [Sitemap](https://multimediainternetnetwork.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL inventory.

## Internet packages

- Standar: 5 Mbps, Rp150.000 per month.
- Basis: 10 Mbps, Rp210.000 per month.
- Premium: 20 Mbps, Rp350.000 per month.

Package availability and installation information should be confirmed with Mitra.net.

## Company

PT Multimedia Internet Network began as an RT RW Net in 2019 and became PT Multimedia Internet Network in 2026. The company states that it provides internet services and related information and communication technology solutions.
